scenes.say: Roomful. Name a few things you love, and walk into the room they make.
Type your favourites. Here: Radiohead, Blade Runner, Haruki Murakami and Muji.
scenes.caption: You type what you love

scenes.say: Qloo finds each one, then answers a question no search engine can: what rooms do people with this taste love? Japanese, intimate, quaint.
scenes.caption: Qloo reads the taste

scenes.say: From the same favourites, Qloo builds the playlist, the shelf and the screen: Sonic Youth and The Smiths, Brave New World, Children of Men. Twenty Qloo calls in all.
scenes.caption: Playlist, shelf and screen, from Qloo

scenes.say: An agent writes the room from those answers alone, and paints it. This is the Quiet Signal Room.
scenes.caption: The room, painted

scenes.say: Every choice names the Qloo result behind it. Anything Qloo did not return is marked unverified, like this one.
scenes.caption: Every choice cites Qloo

scenes.say: Give the same favourites to a language model alone, and none of its eight picks hold up for this taste.
scenes.caption: Without Qloo, 0 of 8 hold up

scenes.say: Then step inside. Roomful paints your room out wider and lifts it into 3D, so you walk into it with W, A, S and D, or in a VR headset.
scenes.caption: Walk inside in 3D

scenes.say: Roomful. A room full of what you love.
